newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWIMMING-NIGERIAN OFFICIALS ALLOWED INTO SWEDEN.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-NIGERIAN OFFICIALS ALLOWED INTO SWEDEN.

text.p: Two Nigerian swimming officials have now been granted visas by Sweden to attend the short course world championships in Gothenburg this month.

Olu Asekun and Chief Thomas, both members of the international swimming federation (FINA), were refused visas in line with a European Union sanction imposed on Nigeria in 1995 to protest about human rights abuses.
But Sweden's Foreign Affairs Ministry spokesman Staffan Bjorck said on Thursday the matter had now been resolved and the officials could attend the championships, starting on April 14.

"The reason is that it was first thought the two were representing Nigeria," Bjorck said. "But it was made clear they are representing FINA and because of that they can attend the meet in Gothenburg."
